atelier.name: The KATHAI Atelier
atelier.description: A 90-minute guided hot chocolate session for 15 guests, engaging all five senses: the cup is made in front of you, cocoa fills the room, a soundscape tuned to sweetness, a warm ceramic cup, and tasting where you create a melt of your own.

products.name: Solé
products.description: Solé starts smooth and chocolatey, lifts into a bright hit of lemon, then melts into a soft coconut finish. Rich on the first sip, citrusy on the finish, with a soft coconut note tying it together.

seo.title: Solé Lemon Coconut Hot Chocolate │ Kathai
seo.meta_description: Bright lemon, creamy coconut, and smooth chocolate come together in Solé, a refreshing and unexpected hot chocolate from Kathai.

products.name: Moss
products.hook: Chocolate and matcha. An unlikely duo that just gets it.
products.description: Deep, velvety chocolate meets the earthy, slightly bitter edge of matcha. Moss opens chocolatey, develops into matcha's grassy depth, and finishes smooth and mellow. The headphones-on, notifications-off flavour.

seo.title: Moss Matcha Hot Chocolate │ Kathai
seo.meta_description: Earthy matcha meets smooth chocolate in Moss, Kathai's mellow tea-inspired hot chocolate made for slower, quieter moments.

products.name: Salora
